name: Javier’s Mexican Food
blocked: DoorDash JSON-LD menu capture is truncated: only 91 of 200 known items landed, and only 10 of the site's own 21 menu categories (per the page's embedded MenuBookCategory metadata) are present. Confirmed correct restaurant/branch (payload streetAddress "197 Woodland Pkwy, San Marcos" matches worklist exactly). Missing entirely: Burritos (30), Drinks (8), Quesadillas (7), Tortas (7), Soup (4), Seafood (3), Tostadas (5), Kids' Menu (4), Side Orders (24), Catering - Half Tray (9), Catering - Full Tray (9), Catering Sides (9); Breakfast Plates also cut short (5 of 7 captured) - a mid-category cut, the classic DoorDash JSON-LD truncation signature. Restaurant's own site (javiersmexicanfood.com) timed out / unreachable from this environment on all 3 resolved IPs - no alternate complete source found within budget.

name: Shiraz Coffee & Deli
notes: Business confirmed closed by two independent sources: Yelp lists it as "SHIRAZ COFFEE & DELI - CLOSED" (updated July 2026) and Checkle's directory shows it closed all days. Could not read either source's page content directly (403 on curl), but the closure fact itself is legible from search-result titles/snippets across independent sites. Retiring as not-found rather than blocked.

name: Heros
blocked: Worklist address is just "2018 Main Street" with no city. The only same-named business found (Hero's Restaurant, 801 National City Blvd, National City, CA) does not match that address and is itself marked CLOSED on Yelp as of January 2026. Could not confirm identity of the actual worklist restaurant; direct source pages (Yelp/menupix) return 403 on curl.

name: Molly Malones Sports Tavern
blocked: needs-browser: same business, same address (1270 Main St, Ramona, CA), rebranded via Bar Rescue to Way Point Saloon (still also called Molly Malone's - confirmed via Instagram @waypointsaloon_mollys and press coverage). Its Popmenu site's /menu page returned a Cloudflare challenge on a plain curl but succeeded with navigation headers; the returned HTML embeds an Apollo/GraphQL cache with 33 MenuSection objects but only 6 MenuItem objects server-rendered - the rest load client-side after JS runs, so a curl-only capture is incomplete. A tier-5 aggregator (menuwithprice.com) has a full priced menu under the old "Molly Malone's" branding, but it cannot be dated and may predate the rebrand, so it was not used as the source without a second independent confirmation.

name: Morena Club
notes: Confirmed closed: Yelp lists it as "MORENA CLUB - CLOSED", and the same address (1319 Morena Blvd, San Diego) has been operating as a different business, The Cordova Bar, since 2018. Retiring as not-found.

name: Mr Gs Tavern
blocked: Conflicting closure signals: Yelp and MenuPix both show Mr G's Tavern (7081 University Ave, La Mesa, CA) as closed, but Foursquare lists active current hours. Worklist has no address to independently confirm identity. Direct source pages (Yelp, menupix) return 403 on curl, so status could not be verified from primary content.

name: Beeside Balcony La Jolla
blocked: Router flagged wrong-branch (Toast payload address "1201 Camino Del Mar" vs worklist's "1025 Prospect St, La Jolla"). beesidebalcony.com now presents as a single-location site ("Beeside Balcony - Olde Del Mar"); a previously-indexed La Jolla-specific page (beesidebalcony.com/beeside-balcony-la-jolla/) now 404s, and guessed location-specific menu URLs either 404 or fall back to generic, price-free content. The only working ordering integration on the site (a SpotApps/Toast widget) resolves to the Del Mar branch, matching the router's original finding. No separate first-party source for the La Jolla location was found; third-party listings (Yelp, Facebook, OpenTable) confirm the location is still open but none expose a directly readable priced menu.

name: Tacos De Birria Mayo
blocked: Address mismatch: the only DoorDash listing found for a similarly-named business ("Tacos De Birria-") sits at 625 H Street, Chula Vista - not the worklist's 2540 Main St Ste D, Chula Vista. A Yelp listing for "Tacos De Birria Mayo" at the correct 2540 Main St address does exist (confirming the worklist address is real) but returns 403 on direct curl, and no delivery-platform listing at that address was found.

name: Fish Restaurant
blocked: Likely identity mismatch on top of a pre-existing markup disqualification. Worklist record has a generic name and no address, paired with thedeadfish.com - which belongs to a real, specific restaurant ("The Dead Fish", 20050 San Pablo Ave, Crockett, CA), several hundred miles from the rest of this batch's San Diego-area restaurants. Even setting that aside, the router already screened out the order.online source: 64 of 102 prices divide cleanly by 1.25 onto round dollars, a delivery-fee markup pattern, not a real menu.
